statement: Change a setting, assignment or conversion in audio with "Update Animation Cache"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Use "Mixdown" in audio; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Bring content into the document in audio with "Open Sound"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Bring content into the document in audio with "Open Sound Mono"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in audio with "Pack Sound"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.

Bring content into the document in audio with "Unpack Sound"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Change a setting, assignment or conversion in audio with "Update Animation"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
